title: InferenceRunnerInputPayload
description: Schema for direct execution input payloads processed by inference_runner.

input_files.description: List of GCS URIs for input files (images/videos).

input_manifest.description: GCS URI pointing to a JSON manifest containing a list/array of input file URIs.

output_path.description: Destination GCS directory path where the model can write arbitrary output files (CSVs, images, sidecars, etc.).

json_output_location.description: Destination GCS file URI where the inference runner writes the raw JSON prediction response.

config.description: Optional model hyperparameters or job settings passed directly to model.py.
